ss-delta 0.4.3 accepts dumps that an older Vita3K decrypted ([#9](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/issues/9)). The setup stopped on them with "eboot.bin is not a build this port supports". Nothing else changed.

## Downloads

| System | Download | Start |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11, x64 | `ss-delta-v0.4.3-windows.zip` | `ss-delta.exe` |
| Linux x64, Steam Deck | `ss-delta-v0.4.3-linux.tar.gz` | `ss-delta.x86_64` |
| macOS 13.3+ on Apple Silicon | `ss-delta-v0.4.3-macos.tar.gz` | `Soul Sacrifice Delta.app` |
| Android 9+, 64-bit ARM with Vulkan | `ss-delta-v0.4.3-android.apk` | **ss-delta** (install the APK) |

On a PC, unpack the archive and start the game. The first time, its importer asks for your own dump of Soul Sacrifice Delta (US PCSA00152 or EU PCSF00532, update 1.30), downloads the PS Vita firmware from Sony and a compiler, and builds the game on your computer in a few minutes. From then on the program goes straight to the game. Nothing of the game is in these downloads. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/docs/INSTALLING.md).

macOS: the app isn't signed by a registered Apple developer, so macOS refuses it the first time. Open System Settings, Privacy & Security, and click "Open Anyway".

## Fixed

* **The setup refused dumps decrypted by an older Vita3K.** Vita3K versions from before December 2024 decrypted the game's files when they installed it. A folder copied out of such an install (often named "[vita3k]") holds those decrypted files instead of the original encrypted ones, so the setup didn't recognise its `eboot.bin`. It is the same 1.30 game, US or EU, and is now accepted. Such a folder needs no `work.bin` or `.rif`.

## Upgrading from 0.4.x

If 0.4.x already built the game for you, you don't need this release. Otherwise, unpack 0.4.3 over your game's folder (replace the files) and start it, or update through RecompLauncher, which then builds the game again from your dump. Coming from 0.3 or older, see [Updating](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/docs/INSTALLING.md#updating).

Every release's changes: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

SHA-256 and build attestations: see the files attached, and `gh attestation verify`.
